hunks.baseline: The battlefield descended into chaos. At the signal, two hundred martial artists suddenly turned and swarmed in every direction like a pack of wolves.
hunks.sol: The battlefield descended into chaos. At the signal, two hundred martial artists suddenly turned on everyone around them and swarmed in from all sides like a pack of wolves.

hunks.baseline: They weren’t quite on the level of Gwak Jun and the assassins we’d fought earlier, but a honed-blade aura still poured off them.
hunks.sol: They weren’t quite on the level of Gwak Jun and the assassins we’d fought earlier, but they still gave off an aura like well-honed blades.

hunks.baseline: The Jin Family of Taiyuan and the Mount Heng Sword Sect. If both factions’ martial artists joined forces, we’d have a real shot—but right now, that looked difficult.
hunks.sol: The Jin Family of Taiyuan and the Mount Heng Sword Sect. If the martial artists of both factions joined forces, they’d have a real chance—but right now, that looked difficult.

hunks.baseline: The moment they saw what was happening in front of them, their eyes all popped wide. Hyuk Mujin, who came crawling up behind them, gaped as well.
hunks.sol: The moment they saw what was happening in front of them, their eyes nearly popped out. Hyuk Mujin, who came crawling up behind them, gaped as well.

hunks.baseline: It must have been rough. After a fast, heavy burst of vomiting, Hyuk looked half-dead as he spoke.
hunks.sol: It must have been rough. After a quick, forceful bout of vomiting, Hyuk looked half-dead as he spoke.

hunks.baseline: Besides, apart from me, Hyuk was the strongest meat shield in the reconnaissance squad. Ah, it kept slipping out.
hunks.sol: Besides, apart from me, Hyuk was the strongest meat shield in the reconnaissance squad. Damn it, that kept slipping out.

hunks.baseline: A twenty-first-century office worker would have spat in your face and walked away, even if you’d offered to file it as a workplace injury. But the reconnaissance squad was more loyal than I’d expected. Hyuk drew his sword with a pale face.
hunks.sol: A twenty-first-century office worker would have spat in your face and walked away, even if you’d offered to file it as a workplace injury. But the reconnaissance squad was more loyal than I’d expected. Hyuk drew his sword, his face pale.

hunks.baseline: “Yes.”
hunks.sol: “No.”

hunks.baseline: Hyuk’s answer was as sharp as a blade, and a light laugh spread through the reconnaissance squad. They’d been frozen stiff by the first large-scale battle of their lives, but they seemed to loosen up a little.
hunks.sol: Hyuk’s cutting answer sent a ripple of quiet laughter through the reconnaissance squad. They’d been frozen stiff by the first large-scale battle of their lives, but they seemed to loosen up a little.

hunks.baseline: I grinned and gripped my spear.
hunks.sol: I grinned and tightened my grip on my spear.

hunks.baseline: At that, we charged forward like a gale. We were an arrow with me at the tip, and the target we had to hit was already set.
hunks.sol: At that, we charged forward like a gale. We were an arrow with me at the tip, and our target had already been chosen.

hunks.baseline: Clear in the distance, I could see a white-haired old man. At his feet lay a fallen man, and a pool of blood.
hunks.sol: Clear in the distance, I could see a white-haired old man. At his feet lay a fallen man in a spreading pool of blood.

hunks.baseline: A hot lump of fire surged up from my gut.
hunks.sol: A ball of fire surged up from my gut.

hunks.baseline: “That’s my brother…”
hunks.sol: “My brother…”

hunks.baseline: The spear shot in a straight line, compressing dozens of yards of distance.
hunks.sol: The spear shot in a straight line, devouring dozens of yards in an instant.

hunks.baseline: A streak of light. The spear split in half and bounced away to either side.
hunks.sol: A streak of light. The spear split in half and flew away to either side.

hunks.baseline: Same result as before. But this time we’d closed the distance considerably, so I could see it clearly.
hunks.sol: The same result as before. But this time we’d closed the distance considerably, so I could see it clearly.

hunks.baseline: A crystallization of mana that only an A-rank Hunter or higher could draw out.
hunks.sol: A crystallization of mana that only an A-rank Hunter or higher could produce.

hunks.baseline: Mana and internal energy were different only in name. In terms of qi, they were the same. And this was Murim, so put another way, it was Sword Energy.
hunks.sol: Mana and internal energy had different names, but both were qi. And this was Murim, so put another way, it was Sword Energy.

hunks.baseline: Heh heh heh.
hunks.sol: *Ha. Ha. Ha.*

hunks.baseline: I’d known for a long time that the Head Elder was a master. I’d even been ready to fight him if it came to that. The problem was that a Head Elder *using Sword Energy* hadn’t been part of the plan.
hunks.sol: I’d known for a long time that the Head Elder was a master. I’d even been prepared to fight him if it came to that. The problem was that a Head Elder *using Sword Energy* hadn’t been part of the plan.

hunks.baseline: I glanced aside and saw ten-odd pairs of shaking eyes.
hunks.sol: I glanced aside and saw ten-odd pairs of trembling eyes.

hunks.baseline: “That just now… that looked like Sword Energy.”
hunks.sol: “That just now… looked like Sword Energy.”

hunks.baseline: Hyuk opened his mouth with a face drained of all color. As far as his skin went, he could have passed for a white man.
hunks.sol: Hyuk spoke with his face drained of all color. As far as skin tone went, he could have passed for a white man.

hunks.baseline: Having failed to win the argument in his head, Hyuk hung his head, looking grim.
hunks.sol: Unable to delude himself any longer, Hyuk hung his head, looking grim.

hunks.baseline: But only for a moment. Step by step. The closer we got to the Head Elder, the more desperately he started hunting for a way out.
hunks.sol: But only for a moment. Step by step. The closer we got to the Head Elder, the more desperately he searched for a way out.

hunks.baseline: “That was the worst case. Wouldn’t it be better to settle this with talk?”
hunks.sol: “That was the worst-case scenario. Wouldn’t it be better to settle this by talking?”

hunks.baseline: “Talk’s good. But they sent assassins after us first.”
hunks.sol: “Talking’s good. But they sent assassins after us first.”

hunks.baseline: When we closed to within about a hundred feet of the Head Elder, Hyuk’s face looked like death. The other reconnaissance squad members didn’t say anything, but I could see them shaking.
hunks.sol: By the time we were within about a hundred feet of the Head Elder, Hyuk’s face looked like death. The other reconnaissance squad members didn’t say anything, but I could see them trembling.

hunks.baseline: Of course, I wasn’t much different. Just thinking about Sword Energy made my chest hammer.
hunks.sol: Of course, I wasn’t much different. Just thinking about Sword Energy made my heart hammer.

hunks.baseline: But I had no intention of running. If I had, I never would have come back in the first place. I would have been content with reality and just lived that way.
hunks.sol: But I had no intention of running. If I had, I never would have come back in the first place. I would have been content with reality and simply gone on living there.

hunks.baseline: Everyone halted as if they’d been waiting for it. Hyuk’s face said he was hoping for a dramatic peace treaty, but I gripped my spear and stepped forward.
hunks.sol: Everyone halted as if they’d been waiting for the order. Hyuk looked as though he was hoping for a dramatic peace treaty, but I gripped my spear and stepped forward.

hunks.baseline: Hyuk looked at me like the sky had fallen, then let out a long sigh.
hunks.sol: Hyuk stared at me as if the sky had fallen, then let out a deep sigh.

hunks.baseline: “Even a meat shield like me should bump our odds up by a hair, shouldn’t it?”
hunks.sol: “Even a meat shield like me should improve our odds by a hair, shouldn’t it?”

hunks.baseline: This guy actually came up with some admirable thoughts.
hunks.sol: This guy was actually capable of such admirable thoughts.

hunks.baseline: I snorted a laugh and turned away.
hunks.sol: I let out a short laugh and turned away.

hunks.baseline: “You going there to die? I’m just going to test the waters and come back. Wait here.”
hunks.sol: “You planning to die? I’m just going to test the waters and come back. Wait here.”

hunks.baseline: A heavy silence crushed the space between us. In that brief interval, my palms went damp.
hunks.sol: A heavy silence pressed down on the space between us. In that brief interval, my palms grew damp.

hunks.baseline: *Phew.*
hunks.sol: *Whew.*

hunks.baseline: But I wasn’t an easy mark either. At Level 30, when I was only Second Rate, I’d already beaten Jopil, a Peak master. And I’d kept improving after I went back to reality.
hunks.sol: But I wasn’t a pushover either. At Level 30, when I was only Second Rate, I’d already beaten Jopil, a Peak master. And I’d continued to improve after returning to reality.

hunks.baseline: At Level 40, I could proudly call myself a master who held his own in both reality and Murim.
hunks.sol: Now that I was Level 40, I was confident I could hold my own in either reality or Murim.

hunks.baseline: *If I fight while keeping as much distance as I can…*
hunks.sol: *If I fight while keeping as much distance as possible…*

hunks.baseline: In a fight where a few centimeters could decide life or death, a spear’s reach was a massive advantage.
hunks.sol: In a fight where a few centimeters could decide life or death, a spear’s reach was a tremendous advantage.

hunks.baseline: I looked at the Head Elder’s face and steadied my breathing.
hunks.sol: I studied the Head Elder’s face and steadied my breathing.

hunks.baseline: I drew up my internal energy in a single burst and charged. Ten feet—the range where my spearhead could reach the Head Elder, and his sword couldn’t reach me.
hunks.sol: I drew up my internal energy in a single burst and charged. Ten feet—the range where my spearhead could reach the Head Elder, but his sword couldn’t reach me.

hunks.baseline: The effect of the Gambler Title, which raised combat-related stats by ten percent in a one-on-one duel, seeped through my whole body.
hunks.sol: The Gambler Title raised combat-related stats by ten percent in a one-on-one duel. Its effect spread throughout my body.

hunks.baseline: The boost to my stats accelerated the attack as well. In an instant, the spearhead dropped like a bolt of light, aimed at the crown of the Head Elder’s head.
hunks.sol: The increase in my stats accelerated the attack as well. In an instant, the spearhead dropped like a bolt of light toward the crown of the Head Elder’s head.

hunks.baseline: *This is going in.*
hunks.sol: *This will land.*

hunks.baseline: That was certainty.
hunks.sol: I was certain of it.

hunks.baseline: The certainty that even a monster like Jopil wouldn’t have been able to dodge it. But the man I was facing wasn’t Jopil.
hunks.sol: Even a monster like Jopil wouldn’t have been able to dodge. But the man I was facing wasn’t Jopil.

hunks.baseline: The spear shaft shuddered with a thunderous crash. The Head Elder, having blocked the spear at a speed too fast to see properly, smiled faintly.
hunks.sol: The spear shaft shuddered with a thunderous crash. The Head Elder had blocked the spear at a speed too fast to follow, and now he smiled faintly.

hunks.baseline: Without even time to answer, I wrung out every last ounce of strength. The spear, loaded with tremendous force that even a decent master would have struggled to endure, crushed down on his sword.
hunks.sol: With no time to answer, I wrung out every last ounce of strength. The spear bore down on his sword with enough force to overwhelm most masters.

hunks.baseline: With an ugly grinding sound, his sword began to lift…
hunks.sol: With an ugly grinding sound, his sword began to rise…

hunks.baseline: I’d put that much force into it, and I was the one being pushed back. At my dumbfounded expression, the Head Elder’s smile deepened.
hunks.sol: I’d put everything I had into it, yet I was the one being pushed back. At my dumbfounded expression, the Head Elder’s smile deepened.

hunks.baseline: The next instant, every hair on my body stood on end.
hunks.sol: The next instant, my hair stood on end.

hunks.baseline: Before I could even react, the spearhead that had been slowly getting pushed back was sliced off like tofu.
hunks.sol: Before I could react, the spearhead that had been slowly forced back was sliced off like tofu.

hunks.baseline: Sword Energy flashed again toward me as I backed away.
hunks.sol: Sword Energy flashed again as I backed away.

hunks.baseline: Fuck. Even nunchaku would be longer than this.
hunks.sol: Fuck. Even a pair of nunchucks would be longer than this.

hunks.baseline: Run? That’s a hurtful thing to say.
hunks.sol: Run? What a hurtful thing to say.

hunks.baseline: I’d already thrown myself sideways at the same moment I threw it. I grabbed the collar of the man lying facedown as if he were dead.
hunks.sol: I’d already thrown myself sideways the instant I hurled the rod. I grabbed the collar of the man lying facedown as if he were dead.

hunks.baseline: Now that I’d done it, there was no reason to fight that monstrous old man. I scooped Jin Wikyung into my arms and hurled myself away with all my strength.
hunks.sol: Now that I’d done it, there was no reason to fight that monstrous old man. I hauled Jin Wikyung into my arms and hurled myself away with all my strength.

hunks.baseline: Hyuk Mujin and the reconnaissance squad surrounded us as we slipped out of the Head Elder’s range by a hair.
hunks.sol: Hyuk Mujin and the reconnaissance squad surrounded us as we escaped the Head Elder’s range by a hair.

hunks.baseline: I said nothing. I forgot we had to run from the Head Elder right now. I even forgot this was a battlefield.
hunks.sol: I said nothing. I forgot that we had to get away from the Head Elder immediately. I even forgot that we were on a battlefield.

hunks.baseline: My head was full of a single question.
hunks.sol: My head was filled with a single question.

hunks.baseline: Then who was this macho middle-aged man in my arms?
hunks.sol: Then who was this macho-looking middle-aged man in my arms?

hunks.baseline: His face was covered in sword scars, and his eyes were bloodshot. In a trembling voice, I asked,
hunks.sol: His face was crisscrossed with blade scars, and his eyes were bloodshot. In a trembling voice, I asked,

hunks.baseline: At that moment, a single cry burst from Hyuk Mujin’s mouth.
hunks.sol: At that moment, a cry burst from Hyuk Mujin’s mouth.

hunks.baseline: Cold sweat rolled down me.
hunks.sol: Cold sweat poured down my back.

hunks.baseline: But Lee Cheonbaek no longer seemed to have the strength left for that.
hunks.sol: But Lee Cheonbaek no longer seemed to have the strength for that.

hunks.baseline: His whole body was covered in blood, and he couldn’t so much as twitch a hand. It looked like severe internal injuries, or like his acupoints had been sealed.
hunks.sol: His entire body was covered in blood, and he couldn’t so much as twitch a finger. It looked as though he’d suffered severe internal injuries, or had his acupoints sealed.

hunks.baseline: I yanked him back by the nape of his neck. A sword came flying in and buried itself where Hyuk’s foot had been a moment before.
hunks.sol: I yanked him back by the nape of his neck. A sword flew in and buried itself where Hyuk’s foot had been a moment before.

hunks.baseline: I let out a long sigh, then went on,
hunks.sol: I let out a deep sigh, then continued.

hunks.baseline: The Head Elder burst into a hearty laugh.
hunks.sol: The Head Elder burst into hearty laughter.

hunks.baseline: “Ha ha ha! Have you ever seen such an insolent brat!”
hunks.sol: “Ha ha ha! What an insolent brat!”

hunks.baseline: I pulled a spear stuck among the corpses. Then, with everyone’s eyes on me, I spoke.
hunks.sol: I pulled a spear free from among the corpses. Then, with everyone’s eyes on me, I spoke.

hunks.baseline: “Encircling formation. Spread out.”
hunks.sol: “Encirclement formation. Spread out.”
